timeoutMs.description: Time limit of one MCP request (connect, list, call). Default 60000.

errorBodyChars.description: Response text kept in an HTTP error (secrets are masked first). Default 300.

stderrChars.description: Tail of a stdio server stderr kept for error messages. Default 2000.

concurrency.description: Tool calls of one turn that run in parallel. Default 8.

timeoutMs.description: Time limit of one tool call (tools may set their own). Default unbounded.

maxResultChars.description: Tool output kept in the conversation; the rest goes to an artifact or is cut. Default 32000.

shellTimeoutMs.description: Time limit of one shell command; the whole process group is killed. Default 120000.

shellMaxOutputChars.description: Shell output collected in memory. Default 100000.

shellExitGraceMs.description: Wait for output after the shell exits while background processes keep the pipes open. Default 200.

maxWalkFiles.description: Files visited by find_files and search_files. Default 20000.

searchMaxResults.description: Matches returned by search_files when the model does not ask for a number. Default 200.

searchMaxFileBytes.description: Larger files are skipped by search_files. Default 1000000.

searchLineChars.description: Characters kept of each matching line. Default 300.

artifactReadChars.description: Characters read_artifact returns when the model gives no limit. Default 8000.

skillMaxFileBytes.description: Largest skill resource file the skill tool loads. Default 1000000.

skillDescriptionChars.description: Characters of each skill description listed in the tool description. Default 300.

maxReasonChars.description: Characters of a PDP reason or error kept in the decision. Default 200.

ttlMs.description: How long a cached response is replayed. Default unbounded.

recallLimit.description: Notes recall returns when the model gives no limit. Default 8.

maxResultsCap.description: Most results the model may ask for. Default 10.

maxChars.description: Characters kept per search snippet. Default 1000.

maxFetchChars.description: Characters kept of a fetched page. Default 8000.

cacheTtlMs.description: In-memory result cache lifetime (0: off). Default 0.

cacheMaxEntries.description: Results kept in the cache. Default 200.

maxTrackedRuns.description: Runs whose search results web_fetch remembers (oldest are forgotten). Default 200.

maxUrlLength.description: Longest URL web_fetch accepts; long URLs can carry exfiltrated data. Default 512.

cacheMaxEntries.description: Results kept in the cache. Default 200.

timeoutMs.description: Time limit of one request to a public API. Default 10000.

errorBodyChars.description: Response text kept in an HTTP error. Default 300.

rateLimitBodyChars.description: Response text kept in a throttling error. Default 200.

maxBodyBytes.description: Largest request body; bigger ones get 413 and the connection is closed. Default 1000000.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Time to receive a whole request (Node default); slow clients cannot hold sockets. Default 300000.

headersTimeoutMs.description: Time to receive the request headers (Node default; never above requestTimeoutMs). Default 60000.

errorDescriptionChars.description: Verifier reason kept in the WWW-Authenticate error_description. Default 120.

maxTurns.description: Turns of an agent that sets no budget; with "unbounded" a looping agent never stops. Default 50.

maxEmptyResponses.description: Empty model responses in a row before the run fails. Default 2.

minSecretChars.description: Shorter secrets are not masked in echoed error text (they would mangle ordinary text). Default 4.
